g.title: j3887967400
g.text: I'm sorry that if by asking about it, I made it hurt.

g.title: j3790107964
g.text: Anything I can do to make it better, or take your mind off it?

g.title: j607497786
g.text: Oh, I'm sorry... bad pain day?

g.title: j1981625473
g.text: Is there something I can do?

g.title: j3568377079
g.text: Vraiment gentil of you, but it is an old problem, nothing worth troubling yourself over. I will be fine.

g.title: j2517406865
g.text: Oui, I am afraid. The mind is a truly marvelous thing. I think it is fascinating that they must always hurt, all the time, and yet I have learned to simply ignore them.

g.title: j2444107420
g.text: Już to robisz, pomagasz mi tą rozmową. Umysł to fascynująca rzecz, prawda ? Mes pieds bolą mnie przez cały czas, a jednak nauczyłam się je ignorować.

g.title: j3359734167

g.title: j3611721542
g.text: Oui, wszystko w porządku. Doceniam twoją troskę, merci.

g.title: j2209963685
g.text: Ha ! To zabawne, non ? Masz rację. Nie myślałam o mes pieds, a teraz o nich myślę i teraz zaczęły mnie boleć.

g.title: j4252189838
g.text: Oui ! Już to robisz, pomagasz mi tą rozmową. Umysł to fascynująca rzecz, prawda ? Mes pieds bolą mnie przez cały czas, a jednak nauczyłam się je ignorować.

g.title: j386645757
g.text: To brzmi męcząco...

g.title: j1180635856
g.text: To brzmi denerwująco.

g.title: j444662937
g.text: Nie ma na to żadnego lekarstwa? Ból nigdy nie ustaje?

g.title: j1676177275
g.text: Jeśli tego chcesz, ale będę w okolicy, jeśli zechcesz porozmawiać.

g.title: j2006970055
g.text: Wiem, jak to jest... Zanim wpadłem w "pętlę", mocno zraniłem się w Duviri. Rany się zagoiły, ale czasami nadal bolą. Staram się nie dać po sobie poznać.

g.title: j1290475412
g.text: Old persistent problems can sometimes be as problematic as new ones. Just because they come and go, and can stay with us, doesn't mean they aren't worth talking about.

g.title: j864510056
g.text: The mind is a truly marvelous thing. I think it is fascinating that they must always hurt, all the time, and yet I have learned to simply ignore them.

g.title: j3475747112
g.text: I'm the same way. The moment I focus on - yeah, there's the pain. Sometimes I wonder if that's why I keep so damn busy.

g.title: j2349231588
g.text: Sometimes I get angry thinking about how much I could get done if I wasn't distracted by the pain all the time.

g.title: j2617861760
g.text: Are you always tired all the time, too? Sometimes I wonder if that's why I'm so exhausted. I'm always spending cycles on being in pain in the background.

g.title: j3059776784
g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j2716662205
g.text: Check boolean MarieSecretPower

g.title: j478944446
g.text: Non... it never stops. I can only distract myself, like in conversations like this. Or by staying busy.

g.title: j3752571194
g.text: You are so very kind, and... very well. I am being little stubborn Marie again.

g.title: j2921818132
g.text: Boolean DrifterChronicPain is now true.

g.title: j279562232
g.text: Oui, you are right. I am being little stubborn Marie again.

g.text: Oui, it is. Par exemple -

g.title: j1821707805

g.title: j3294955257
g.text: Oui, it is. I sometimes would sit there and stare at a book on the top row of a case and think how unjust it was that I could not reach it.

g.title: j1203521695
g.text: I was dusting all the chandeliers the other day in the Sanctum. Monsieur Loid begged me to stop.

g.title: j3852209197
g.text: It is a hard thing to explain, but I will try. Mes pieds, oui ? My feet. The sérum has changed me, given me flight -

g.title: j2048358803
g.text: Par les Luminaires, I am so very sorry. You understand then, what it is like, oui ?

g.title: j1108495155
g.text: Oui ! Oh, I was dusting all the chandeliers the other day in the Sanctum. Monsieur Loid begged me to stop.

g.title: j2627672181
g.text: But it is like you said, non ? All inconveniences like ours come with a secret power. We must simply find them.

g.title: j1449397790
g.text: Oui, I know your frustration. I sometimes would sit there and stare at a book on the top row of a case and think how unjust it was that I could not reach it.

g.title: j1378819069->j1449397790
g.text: false

g.title: j2346669413
g.text: Oui !! Oh, you do understand !! Par exemple -

g.title: j109733424
g.text: Do you know how tiring it is to have to float all the time, jour après jour, heure après heure, when others may walk ?

g.title: j1285405215
g.text: But yes, it is frustrating. I sometimes would sit there and stare at a book on the top row of a case and think how unjust it was that I could not reach it.

g.title: j2342117666
g.text: That it contained knowledge that I cared about, no one else, so why was I denied it ? And along would come some helpful soul who would pluck it from its place for me out of pity...

g.title: j604117044
g.text: I told him I needed to stay busy, needed to keep my hands moving. I do not think he quite understood why I must stay so active.

g.title: j2040449123
g.text: But I still feel them, those twisted things that threatened to consume me, threatened to crush all hope and joie from my soul.

g.title: j3362616962
g.text: To have a body that betrays you, that slows your spirit down. Even now, it is so strange. The sérum has changed me, given me flight -

g.title: j1038286868
g.text: I told him I needed to stay busy, needed to keep my hands moving. I do not think he quite understood why I must stay so active.

g.title: j2913643930
g.text: But I know your frustration. Oh, I know it well. I sometimes would sit there and stare at a book on the top row of a case and think how unjust it was that I could not reach it.

g.title: j797488188
g.text: That it contained knowledge that I cared about, no one else, so why was I denied it ? And along would come some helpful soul who would pluck it from its place for me out of pity...

g.title: j2971359346
g.text: Do you know how tiring it is to have to float all the time, jour après jour, heure après heure, when others may walk ?

g.title: j3132781002
g.text: I am ravie to be so mobile, to be able to reach anything I wish, do not mistake me. But it is still so exhausting !

g.title: j2548880568
g.text: And it is not their fault, for they are doing an act of kindness - I needed the help. And it is not their fault that I needed it. But oh, how frustrating it is to need that assistance.

g.title: j1491658648
g.text: It is just... so nice to be able to speak of all this. I cannot properly put it into words. It is so rare to be able to discuss this kind of unseen, silent plague I suffer.

g.title: j2044996201
g.text: Always they hurt. Always. Even now, as I sit here, if I think of them, I feel the pain. But it is not always enough that I notice.

g.title: j4126753394
g.text: But I still feel them, those twisted things that threatened to consume me, threatened to crush all hope and joie from my soul.

g.title: j662552122
g.text: Ah, it just brings me happiness to know that someone here understands what it is like. It is so rare. This silent, unseen plague we suffer.

g.title: j2498572706
g.text: What's wrong with that?

g.title: j2623889076
g.text: Yeah. I know. And it's not their fault.

g.title: j3552115159
g.text: I am ravie to be so mobile, to be able to reach anything I wish, do not mistake me. But it is still so exhausting !!

g.title: j2530589018
g.text: I'm so sorry you have to put up with all that.

g.title: j1784585217
g.text: And you can't even express that frustration.

g.title: j2862224822
g.text: Like a tiny little abeille that sits upon my shoulder and stings me every day. Not enough to destroy, just enough to be a nuisance.

g.title: j235035758
g.text: Always they hurt. Always. Even now, as I sit here, if I think of them, I feel the pain. But it is not always enough that I notice.

g.title: j865060800
g.text: Like a tiny little abeille that sits upon us and stings us every day. Not enough to destroy us, just enough to bother us.

g.title: j2694033450
g.text: Nothing ! Nothing is wrong. I needed the help. But that is the root of it, I needed the help. And it is, as you said... frustrating.

g.title: j889588977
g.text: Oui ! It is not their fault, for they are doing an act of kindness - I needed the help. And it is not their fault that I needed it. But oh, how frustrating it is to need that assistance.

g.text: +10 Chemistry

g.title: j2983474364
g.text: Well, I wish it would go away...

g.title: j3815931453
g.text: As do I ! But in the same way, it makes us part of who we are, non ? Who are we to say what parts of us are the important ones, and what parts are not ?

g.title: j1754583236
g.text: Oh ! A tiny little thing, yellow and black, stripes, has a needle on its derrière... produces honey ?

g.title: j2427033551

g.title: j3606768880
g.text: Oh, a bee!

g.title: j3990818829
g.text: No, not getting it... keep going.

g.title: j2410508255
g.text: I will not speak of faith except to say that... flawed as we must think our forms from this limited view, we must... be at peace with what we are, non ? It is all we have.

g.title: j2427033551->j2410508255

g.title: j1724918538
g.text: I know our faiths are similar in shape, so I will say that... Sol saw fit to make me as I am, and I must have faith in his design, non ? Flawed as I may think it from my limited view. I would wonder if you could not consider the same of yours.

But I will simply say that Sol saw fit to make me as I am, and I must have faith in his design, non ? Flawed as I may think it from my limited view. I would wonder if you could not consider the same of yours.

g.title: j3549923950
g.text: Lua uznała za stosowne uczynić cię takim, jakim jesteś, a Sol uczynił mnie taką, jaką jestem ja. Musimy zaufać w ich decyzje, non ? Nawet jeśli wydają się błędne.

g.title: j2662216503
